ui.title: Groove Guide
ui.hi: Hi! This is the GROOVE N SPOT guide. Tap a question or type yours.
ui.fallback: I can't answer that one for sure. Ask us on WhatsApp or Instagram DM, or use the booking page — our team will reply.

items.a: Open 365 nights a year: Sun–Thu 9:30 PM – 6 AM, Fri, Sat and nights before public holidays 9 PM – 7 AM.
52 Jungang-daero 680beonga-gil, Busanjin-gu, Busan (2F–3F). 3 min walk from Seomyeon Station Exit 3. Open map →

items.q: Can foreigners and tourists get in?
items.a: Yes, foreigners are very welcome. Please bring your physical passport — photos or copies are not accepted.

items.q: Is there an entry fee / cover charge?
items.a: No — entry is free. Order drinks at the bar or book a table / bottle set.
Yes. Overly casual wear, training wear (tracksuits) and slippers or sports sandals may be refused at the door.

items.q: How do I book a table?
items.a: Use the Reserve page, DM us on Instagram or WhatsApp (@groovenspot), or call +82-507-1301-5970 with your date and party size.

items.q: What kind of music do you play?
items.a: 2F GROOVE plays hip-hop, R&B and all kinds of music; 3F SPOT is EDM. Resident and guest DJs play every night.

items.q: Where can I see tonight's DJ timetable?
items.a: Every afternoon the night's timetable is posted on Instagram @groovenspot (stories) and on the events page of this website.
19+ (Korean age) with valid ID required. Passport or driver's license accepted.

items.q: Can I walk in without booking?
items.a: Walk-ins welcome, but we recommend guestlist or a table on Fri–Sat.
No private parking — use public lots near Seomyeon Station. Taxi or metro recommended!
There is a smoking room on the 3rd floor.
DM us on Instagram @groovenspot or give us a call.
